bug_1_fy_selection.description: Inventory page not changing with FY selection
evidence: Backend: GET /api/inventory/items?fy=2025-26 returns different quantities than ?fy=2026-27
Example: AXLE 85W140 GL5 5LT (4PC) - FY 2025-26: 20, FY 2026-27: 16
Example: COLDSTAR COOLANT GREEN 1:5 1LT (20PC) - FY 2025-26: 1000, FY 2026-27: 920
Frontend: FY selector in navbar triggers fetchInventory with selectedFY param (line 29, 37 in Inventory.js)

bug_2_sort_function.description: Need sort function on Quantity and Value columns
evidence: Frontend: SortHeader component exists for quantity and value columns (lines 136-139 in Inventory.js)
Frontend: handleSort function toggles sortField and sortDir (lines 131-134)
Frontend: filteredItems.sort() applies sorting (lines 121-129)
Playwright test: Quantity sort ascending shows [0,0,0,0,0], descending shows [1000,432,200,180,168]
App.js uses handleLogoutRef.current pattern (line 230, 250, 352)
IDLE_LIMIT = 14 minutes, LOGOUT_DELAY = 1 minute (total 15 minutes)
resetIdle function clears and resets timers on user activity
handleLogoutRef.current is set to handleLogout on line 352, ensuring fresh reference

bug_4_ai_po_crash.description: AI PO crashing with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading toLocaleString)'
evidence: Inventory.js lines 381-398: All PO item fields use null-safe patterns
estimated_cost: (item.estimated_cost || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')
current_stock: item.current_stock ?? '-'
reorder_level: item.reorder_level ?? '-'
recommended_quantity: item.recommended_quantity ?? '-'
priority: (item.priority || 'medium').toUpperCase()
Backend test confirms PO generation returns valid data with numeric fields

bug_5_auto_reorder.description: Auto reorder level says 'no sales data found'
evidence: Fixed NoneType error in inventory.py line 1175 (ctx.get when ctx is None)
Backend now uses: ctx.get('tenant_id', '') if ctx else ''
POST /api/inventory/auto-reorder-levels returns success with updated count
Test result: 'Reorder levels set for 172 items (2-month stock)'
